summary_plain: Bull kept his plan (buy at 158.76, exit at 158.61, goal 159.00, pays 1.6 for each 1 risked) and openly agreed it has no proven edge. The desk replayed it 10,000 times: the goal came first 36 times in 100 and the exit first 62 times, but it needs about 38 wins to break even, so it loses a little on average. Bear used Bull's own honesty, pointed out that all four other versions Bull tried also fall short, and noted a US bond sale at 18:00 UTC is minutes away. Bull's capped risk is real, but a small bet that loses slightly is still a losing bet.

best_point_plain.bull: He was honest: the most you can lose is 0.15, the dollar is strong, no big event is scheduled, and he tested wider versions instead of hiding the thin odds.
best_point_plain.bear: Small size makes a bet cheaper, not better: the plan wins 36 times in 100 when it needs 38, and every version Bull tried also lands just under break-even.
